욥기 40:1.content: Moreover the Lord answered Job, and said,

욥기 40:2.content: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.

욥기 40:3.content: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,

욥기 40:4.content: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.

욥기 40:5.content: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.

욥기 40:6.content: Then answered the Lord unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

욥기 40:7.content: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

욥기 40:8.content: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?

욥기 40:9.content: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

욥기 40:10.content: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.

욥기 40:11.content: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.

욥기 40:12.content: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.

욥기 40:13.content: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.

욥기 40:14.content: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.

욥기 40:15.content: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.

욥기 40:16.content: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.

욥기 40:17.content: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.

욥기 40:18.content: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.

욥기 40:19.content: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.

욥기 40:20.content: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.

욥기 40:21.content: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.

욥기 40:22.content: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.

욥기 40:23.content: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.

욥기 40:24.content: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.
